title: Bessent Previews 'Economic D-Day' Against Iran in Financial Times Op-Ed
detail: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent wrote in a Financial Times op-ed published Sunday night that an 'economic D-Day' against Iran was imminent, calling it 'the single greatest financial offensive ever marshalled against an adversary' and vowing to 'sever every economic lifeline that sustains the tyrannical regime until Tehran stands alone.' The op-ed gave little detail but previewed a Monday announcement targeting countries that continue trading with Tehran, nearly six months into a conflict that has kept the Strait of Hormuz and Gulf energy exports disrupted.

media.caption: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who previewed the sanctions push in a Sunday night Financial Times op-ed
